profile.headline: Software Engineer with Android, iOS, and Full Stack experience
profile.summary:
Software Developer with a B.S. in Computer Science. Experience in Android and full stack development using React, Node.js, MongoDB, and Express. 

Some project examples include:

- Devjobs, Full stack  job board website built using React, Node.js, MongoDB, and Express. It includes user profiles, CRUD functionality for job postings, filtered searches, a dark mode toggle, and URL path-based page creation.

- Care Corner, an Android application to improve user safety. It includes GPS tracking using HERE, MMS messaging using Twilio, audio recording, event tracking, and an AWS ready backend using LocalStack, Serverless Framework and Docker.


I get excited about opportunities to collaborate, problem solve, and learn, all while delivering polished products to meet client needs. 

I look forward to connecting with new people. You can reach me at thorrellt@gmail.com

positions.title: Associate in the Public Information Office
positions.description:
Staff member of the Public Information Office who aids residents of Montgomery County, Maryland in acquiring public information, accessing resources, and receiving county services.

● Created the MC 311 Notes Tool after recognizing redundancies when creating requests. This resulted in an average reduction in handle time of 15%.

positions.title: Lead Billing Coordinator
positions.description:
Served multiple roles within this startup tech company centered around seniors. Oversaw the billing and collections team in addition to assisting in the maintenance of the company’s IT infrastructure.

● Crafted and rolled out new practices after identifying inefficiencies in the billing procedures. The resulting changes decreased account delinquencies by 17% in Q1-2019.

● Refined the billing coordinator role by writing nine procedural documentations for future billing coordinators.

● Organized a repeatable system to gather, analyze, and output billing and collections data. Delivered data, via a report, to the CEO three to five times per month.

positions.title: Banking Service Representative
positions.description:
Addressed user’s banking and technical issues by leveraging a solution-oriented communication style to troubleshoot.

● Designed, wrote, and maintained three Intranet pages for two lines of business, using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

● Achieved the rank of #2 in 2017 for call quality in the department.

positions.title: Recoveries Service Representative
positions.description:
Managed a six-figure portfolio of high balanced accounts, that ranged in age from one to seven years, to recoup written-off debts.

● Co-founded a committee focused on driving a digital initiative throughout all lines of business. Delivered employee training integral to the rollout of new technologies.

● Achieved the rank of #1 in 2014 for call quality in the department.

positions.title: Escalation Specialist
positions.description:
Handled escalated cases for customers unable to resolve their past due accounts due to experiencing extreme financial hardships, or those filing for bankruptcy.

● Elected to improve and manage the department's information board, which included the development of monthly presentations to the leadership team about the department’s performance.

● Obtained the 6th highest agent score, a metric measuring overall performance, within the unit in 2013, which contributed to 2nd promotion in 2014.
